reviewSamples.author: Carline Casimir
reviewSamples.text: I hired Carlos from DeJesus Stump Removal to trim a very big mahogany tree also to trim and remove some bushes. They did an exceptional job and their prices were very fair. I have & would definitely recommend this company for any work that you need. They are also very friendly and nice.

reviewSamples.author: Tomas
reviewSamples.text: Carlos and his team came to trim the mature oaks and they did a phenomenal job. They took their time and went above and beyond to trim and make sure everything was cleaned up after. Highly recommended.

reviewSamples.author: Lina Rodriguez
reviewSamples.text: We can't express how happy we are that we chose De Jesus Stump Removal. The job was done quickly and with exceptional quality, we truly appreciate your hard work. Thank you again! We will definitely be recommending your services to others.

reviewSamples.author: God Made Dog Rescue & Adoptions, Inc.
reviewSamples.text: Incredible service they were very professional and I highly recommend them. Carlos the owner and his team listened to all my wants and desires. They cleaned my home and the homes next to me.

reviewSamples.author: Nancy Hand
reviewSamples.text: We were advised by an arborist of a terminally diseased 50' oak in our front lawn. We called several companies recommended by the arborist and selected DeJesus Stump Removal for the job. Carlos was very knowledgeable, professional, and...
